model.title: Providing for congressional disapproval under chapter 8 of title 5, United States Code, of the rule submitted by the Environmental Protection Agency relating to "California State Nonroad Engine Pollution Control Standards; Ocean-Going Vessels At-Berth; Notice of Decision".
model.meta: Energy and Commerce Committee · Rep. Vince Fong (R-CA)

summary.text: The joint resolution would cancel the Environmental Protection Agency's approval of California's plan to tighten pollution limits on ocean-going ships while docked at ports, which would have expanded the rules to apply to more types of vessels. It seeks to undo a specific EPA authorization decision that allowed California to strengthen its emissions requirements for these ships' auxiliary engines.
